_about: Lorefi capability/risk matrix. color drives the go/no-go call per (domain, task_type). green = standard delivery / go, yellow = deliverable but scope + caveats required, red = escalate / likely no-go. escalation_rules always fire regardless of color.

color_notes.green: Standard delivery. Known playbook, staffable from the bench.
color_notes.yellow: Deliverable with scoping: extra QA, SME review, or compliance caveats. Tighten acceptance criteria.
color_notes.red: Escalate to leadership. Regulatory, safety, or capability risk; default to no-go pending review.

escalation_rules.label: PII / regulated data
escalation_rules.note: Transcript signals PII, PHI, PCI, or otherwise regulated data. Always escalate for compliance review even on a green cell.

escalation_rules.label: Non-English data
escalation_rules.note: Source data is non-English or multilingual. Requires language-qualified contributors and QA; escalate for staffing.

escalation_rules.label: Non-standard platform / delivery
escalation_rules.note: Customer requires delivery on a non-standard platform, on-prem, air-gapped, or bespoke tooling. Escalate for solutioning.

escalation_rules.label: Extreme complexity
escalation_rules.note: Task complexity, taxonomy depth, or expertise bar is far above baseline. Escalate for feasibility and pricing.

escalation_rules.label: New modality – audio/video
escalation_rules.note: Audio or video modality outside current standard pipelines. Escalate for capability and tooling assessment.
